title: Vulnerable google-cloud-aiplatform SDK install (<1.148.0)
id: 7e2c4d3b-1f8a-4a90-9c3e-9b8f5d2b6f10
description: Detects pip/poetry/uv installing google-cloud-aiplatform at a version below the 1.148.0 patch for Pickle-in-the-Middle bucket squatting.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/google-vertex-ai-sdk-flaw-let-attackers.html
  - https://github.com/googleapis/python-aiplatform/releases/tag/v1.148.0
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.t1195.001
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\pip.exe'
      - '\pip3.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\poetry.exe'
      - '\uv.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'google-cloud-aiplatform=='
      - 'google-cloud-aiplatform<'
      - 'google_cloud_aiplatform=='
  filter_safe:
    CommandLine|re: 'google[-_]cloud[-_]aiplatform[=<]=?(1\.(14[89]|1[5-9][0-9]|[2-9][0-9]{2,})|[2-9]\.|[1-9][0-9]+\.)'

| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` 
| rex field=process "google[-_]cloud[-_]aiplatform[=<>!]+(?<version>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" 
| where isnotnull(version)
